subject: Web Development
title: HTTPS and TLS
description: A 60-second lesson on HTTPS and TLS.

hook.text: On HTTP, every message between browser and server travels in plain text anyone can read.

buildup.text: TLS encrypts the connection. HTTPS means your data is scrambled in transit.

discovery.text: Let's Encrypt made TLS certificates free in 2015, removing the biggest barrier to HTTPS.

twist.text: Before Let's Encrypt, certificates cost hundreds of dollars per year. Many sites skipped security.

climax.text: Today browsers mark HTTP sites as 'Not Secure.' HTTPS is the baseline, not a bonus.

punchline.text: Encryption went from luxury to minimum standard.

quiz.question: What did Let's Encrypt change about TLS?
